baselineNote: Reviewed app improvements, reports and harness checkpointed on main before new-game implementation. See handoffs/BASELINE.md.

tasks.goal: Install English agent instructions, staged task/worktree tooling, and replaceable UI boundaries.
acceptance: Manifest and role profiles validate
Worktree checks reject missing baseline, dirty checkout, and inactive tasks
No app source or runtime settings changed

tasks.goal: Define independent screen state/actions, domain/adapter interfaces, resource tokens and a minimal preview shell.
acceptance: UI reads state and emits actions without storage/sensor/game-rule calls
Fake adapters render a screen without camera/GPS/network
A token/layout-only change leaves behavior tests unchanged
Legacy app remains runnable until integration is authorized

tasks.goal: Implement versioned per-building progress, free order, quiz eligibility, scoring and local repository adapters.
acceptance: Multiple waiting buildings and restart preserve independent eligibility
2/3 pass, retries and shuffled choices preserve answer identity
Duplicate rewards are prevented
Legacy data migration/isolation policy is documented and tested

tasks.goal: Build camera-overlay discovery, orientation and summon actions with explicit fallbacks.
acceptance: Camera denial/absence does not trap the user
Distinct movement pulses are not duplicate samples
Unavailable/too-dark light input has a recoverable path
Overlay is never reported as tracked AR

tasks.goal: Build sentence-level TTS/captions, quiz/result screens and best-effort notifications.
acceptance: No TTS voice still allows readable introduction
Replay/skip rules do not duplicate or reset eligibility unexpectedly
Late/denied notification does not block an eligible quiz
Interruption/recreation preserve the chosen quiz attempt policy

tasks.goal: Build home/map/profile/ending surfaces using stable state contracts.
acceptance: Free-order progress and waiting quizzes are understandable
Illustrated map coordinate mapping is explicit, not guessed
Unknown departments are not falsely labeled digital-info students
Tokens/assets/layout can be replaced without domain changes

tasks.goal: Integrate one complete building first, then expand validated content to five.
acceptance: One complete loop passes before expanding content
Required Gradle checks and independent review pass
Screenshots identify real APK vs simulated input
Real-device/field limits and debug-mode evidence remain separate

tasks.goal: Add only explicitly selected Firebase identity/sync adapters.
acceptance: Ownership rules and account isolation are tested
Offline/retry/reset conflicts have defined behavior
Actual configured login/sync is distinguished from mock tests

tasks.goal: Add bounded official-source RAG without coupling quiz progress to network availability.
acceptance: API keys remain server-side
Answers cite known source documents or abstain
Quota/network failure leaves exploration usable
Identity strategy and scope are resolved before implementation

tasks.goal: Apply selected design references by changing presentation, tokens and assets.
acceptance: No domain/device/storage logic changes are needed for visual-only requirements
Behavior checks remain green
Reference-based visual QA checks text, spacing, scrolling and accessibility
